preconditions.description: The integer n is between 4 and 255 inclusive.
The string s has length exactly n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ACGT?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of characters 'A', 'C', 'G', 'T', and '?'.

postconditions.expression: target == n // 4 and n % 4 == 0 and all(s.count(c) <= target for c in 'ACGT') and (stdout == '===' or (len(stdout.strip()) == n and all(c in 'ACGT' for c in stdout.strip()) and all(stdout.strip().count(c) == target for c in 'ACGT') and all((s[i] == '?' or s[i] == stdout.strip()[i]) for i in range(n))))
postconditions.description: If n is not divisible by 4 or any nucleotide count exceeds n/4, output '==='; otherwise, output a string of length n containing only 'A','C','G','T' where each appears exactly n/4 times, and every non-'?' character in s matches the corresponding character in the output.
